## 1075. Quantization for Cost Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.quantization as quantization
import time
import copy
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional, Any, Union
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
import numpy as np

class QuantizationType(Enum):
    DYNAMIC = "dynamic"
    STATIC = "static"
    QAT = "qat"  # Quantization Aware Training
    FP16 = "fp16"
    INT8 = "int8"
    INT4 = "int4"

class QuantizationBackend(Enum):
    FBGEMM = "fbgemm"  # CPU
    QNNPACK = "qnnpack"  # Mobile
    ONEDNN = "onednn"   # Intel

@dataclass
class QuantizationConfig:
    quantization_type: QuantizationType
    backend: QuantizationBackend
    calibration_samples: int = 100
    per_channel: bool = True
    reduce_range: bool = False

@dataclass
class QuantizationMetrics:
    original_size_mb: float
    quantized_size_mb: float
    size_reduction: float
    inference_speedup: float
    accuracy_drop: float
    memory_reduction: float
    cost_reduction: float

class DynamicQuantizer:
    """Dynamic quantization implementation"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def quantize_model(model: nn.Module, 
                      qconfig_spec: Optional[Dict] = None) -> nn.Module:
        """Apply dynamic quantization to model"""
        
        if qconfig_spec is None:
            # Default quantization for Linear and LSTM layers
            qconfig_spec = {
                nn.Linear: torch.quantization.default_dynamic_qconfig,
                nn.LSTM: torch.quantization.default_dynamic_qconfig
            }
        
        model_copy = copy.deepcopy(model)
        model_copy.eval()
        
        quantized_model = torch.quantization.quantize_dynamic(
            model_copy,
            qconfig_spec,
            dtype=torch.qint8
        )
        
        return quantized_model
    
    @staticmethod
    def quantize_linear_layers(model: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
        """Quantize only linear layers dynamically"""
        return DynamicQuantizer.quantize_model(
            model, 
            {nn.Linear: torch.quantization.default_dynamic_qconfig}
        )

class StaticQuantizer:
    """Static quantization implementation"""
    
    def __init__(self, backend: QuantizationBackend = QuantizationBackend.FBGEMM):
        self.backend = backend.value
        torch.backends.quantized.engine = self.backend
    
    def prepare_model(self, model: nn.Module, 
                     example_inputs: torch.Tensor,
                     per_channel: bool = True) -> nn.Module:
        """Prepare model for static quantization"""
        
        model_copy = copy.deepcopy(model)
        model_copy.eval()
        
        # Set quantization config
        if per_channel:
            qconfig = torch.quantization.get_default_qconfig(self.backend)
        else:
            qconfig = torch.quantization.default_qconfig
        
        model_copy.qconfig = qconfig
        
        # Prepare for static quantization
        prepared_model = torch.quantization.prepare(model_copy)
        
        return prepared_model
    
    def calibrate_model(self, 
                       prepared_model: nn.Module,
                       calibration_loader: torch.utils.data.DataLoader,
                       num_batches: int = 100) -> nn.Module:
        """Calibrate model with representative data"""
        
        prepared_model.eval()
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch_idx, (data, _) in enumerate(calibration_loader):
                if batch_idx >= num_batches:
                    break
                _ = prepared_model(data)
        
        return prepared_model
    
    def quantize_model(self, calibrated_model: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
        """Convert calibrated model to quantized version"""
        return torch.quantization.convert(calibrated_model)

class QATQuantizer:
    """Quantization Aware Training implementation"""
    
    def __init__(self, backend: QuantizationBackend = QuantizationBackend.FBGEMM):
        self.backend = backend.value
        torch.backends.quantized.engine = self.backend
    
    def prepare_qat_model(self, model: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
        """Prepare model for quantization aware training"""
        
        model_copy = copy.deepcopy(model)
        model_copy.train()
        
        # Set QAT qconfig
        model_copy.qconfig = torch.quantization.get_default_qat_qconfig(self.backend)
        
        # Prepare for QAT
        prepared_model = torch.quantization.prepare_qat(model_copy)
        
        return prepared_model
    
    def train_qat_model(self, 
                       qat_model: nn.Module,
                       train_loader: torch.utils.data.DataLoader,
                       epochs: int = 5,
                       lr: float = 0.001) -> nn.Module:
        """Train model with quantization aware training"""
        
        optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(qat_model.parameters(), lr=lr)
        criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
        
        qat_model.train()
        
        for epoch in range(epochs):
            for batch_idx, (data, target) in enumerate(train_loader):
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                output = qat_model(data)
                loss = criterion(output, target)
                loss.backward()
                optimizer.step()
                
                if batch_idx % 100 == 0:
                    print(f"QAT Epoch {epoch}, Batch {batch_idx}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}")
        
        return qat_model
    
    def convert_qat_model(self, qat_model: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
        """Convert QAT model to quantized inference model"""
        qat_model.eval()
        return torch.quantization.convert(qat_model)

class MixedPrecisionQuantizer:
    """Mixed precision quantization (FP16/FP32)"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def convert_to_fp16(model: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
        """Convert model to FP16"""
        model_copy = copy.deepcopy(model)
        return model_copy.half()
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_amp_model(model: nn.Module) -> Tuple[nn.Module, torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler]:
        """Create model for Automatic Mixed Precision"""
        scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler()
        return model, scaler
    
    @staticmethod
    def amp_forward(model: nn.Module, 
                   data: torch.Tensor,
                   target: torch.Tensor,
                   criterion: nn.Module,
                   scaler: torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler,
                   optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Forward pass with AMP"""
        
        with torch.cuda.amp.autocast():
            output = model(data)
            loss = criterion(output, target)
        
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        
        return loss

class CustomQuantizer:
    """Custom quantization implementations"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def linear_quantization(tensor: torch.Tensor, 
                          num_bits: int = 8,
                          signed: bool = True) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, float, int]:
        """Apply linear quantization to tensor"""
        
        if signed:
            qmin = -(2 ** (num_bits - 1))
            qmax = 2 ** (num_bits - 1) - 1
        else:
            qmin = 0
            qmax = 2 ** num_bits - 1
        
        # Calculate scale and zero point
        min_val = tensor.min().item()
        max_val = tensor.max().item()
        
        scale = (max_val - min_val) / (qmax - qmin)
        zero_point = qmin - min_val / scale
        zero_point = int(np.round(np.clip(zero_point, qmin, qmax)))
        
        # Quantize
        quantized = torch.round(tensor / scale + zero_point)
        quantized = torch.clamp(quantized, qmin, qmax)
        
        return quantized.to(torch.int8 if signed else torch.uint8), scale, zero_point
    
    @staticmethod
    def dequantize(quantized_tensor: torch.Tensor, 
                  scale: float, 
                  zero_point: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Dequantize tensor"""
        return (quantized_tensor.float() - zero_point) * scale
    
    @staticmethod
    def quantize_layer_weights(layer: nn.Module, num_bits: int = 8) -> nn.Module:
        """Quantize layer weights"""
        if hasattr(layer, 'weight') and layer.weight is not None:
            quantized_weight, scale, zero_point = CustomQuantizer.linear_quantization(
                layer.weight.data, num_bits
            )
            
            # Store quantization parameters
            layer.weight_scale = scale
            layer.weight_zero_point = zero_point
            layer.weight.data = CustomQuantizer.dequantize(
                quantized_weight, scale, zero_point
            )
        
        return layer

class QuantizationOptimizer:
    """Optimize quantization for cost reduction"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.quantization_methods = {
            QuantizationType.DYNAMIC: DynamicQuantizer(),
            QuantizationType.STATIC: StaticQuantizer(),
            QuantizationType.QAT: QATQuantizer(),
            QuantizationType.FP16: MixedPrecisionQuantizer()
        }
    
    def benchmark_quantization_methods(self, 
                                     model: nn.Module,
                                     test_data: torch.Tensor,

                                     train_loader: Optional[torch.utils.data.DataLoader] = None) -> Dict[str, QuantizationMetrics]:
        """Benchmark different quantization methods"""
        
        results = {}

        # Test dynamic quantization

        dynamic_model = DynamicQuantizer.quantize_linear_layers(model)
        results['dynamic'] = self._evaluate_quantized_model(
            original_model=model,
            quantized_model=dynamic_model,
            test_data=test_data,
            original_size=original_size,

        )
        
        # Test static quantization (if calibration data available)
        if calibration_loader is not None:
            print("Testing static quantization...")
            static_quantizer = StaticQuantizer()
            prepared_model = static_quantizer.prepare_model(model, test_data[:1])
            calibrated_model = static_quantizer.calibrate_model(prepared_model, calibration_loader)
            static_model = static_quantizer.quantize_model(calibrated_model)
            
            results['static'] = self._evaluate_quantized_model(
                original_model=model,
                quantized_model=static_model,
                test_data=test_data,
                original_size=original_size,
                method_name="static"
            )
        
        # Test FP16 quantization
        if torch.cuda.is_available():
            print("Testing FP16 quantization...")
            fp16_model = MixedPrecisionQuantizer.convert_to_fp16(model)
            results['fp16'] = self._evaluate_quantized_model(
                original_model=model,
                quantized_model=fp16_model,
                test_data=test_data.half() if torch.cuda.is_available() else test_data,
                original_size=original_size,
                method_name="fp16"
            )
        
        # Test QAT (if training data available)
        if train_loader is not None:
            print("Testing Quantization Aware Training...")
            qat_quantizer = QATQuantizer()
            qat_model = qat_quantizer.prepare_qat_model(model)
            trained_qat_model = qat_quantizer.train_qat_model(qat_model, train_loader, epochs=2)
            final_qat_model = qat_quantizer.convert_qat_model(trained_qat_model)
            
            results['qat'] = self._evaluate_quantized_model(
                original_model=model,
                quantized_model=final_qat_model,
                test_data=test_data,
                original_size=original_size,
                method_name="qat"
            )
        
        return results
    
    def _evaluate_quantized_model(self, 
                                 original_model: nn.Module,
                                 quantized_model: nn.Module,
                                 test_data: torch.Tensor,
                                 original_size: float,
                                 method_name: str) -> QuantizationMetrics:
        """Evaluate quantized model performance"""
        
        # Calculate model sizes
        quantized_size = self._calculate_model_size(quantized_model)
        size_reduction = (original_size - quantized_size) / original_size
        
        # Benchmark inference speed
        speedup = self._benchmark_inference_speed(original_model, quant
```python
        speedup = self._benchmark_inference_speed(original_model, quantized_model, test_data)
        
        # Estimate accuracy drop (simplified - would need actual validation data)
        accuracy_drop = self._estimate_accuracy_drop(original_model, quantized_model, test_data)
        
        # Calculate memory reduction
        memory_reduction = self._estimate_memory_reduction(method_name, size_reduction)
        
        # Calculate cost reduction
        cost_reduction = self._calculate_cost_reduction(size_reduction, speedup, memory_reduction)
        
        return QuantizationMetrics(
            original_size_mb=original_size,
            quantized_size_mb=quantized_size,
            size_reduction=size_reduction,
            inference_speedup=speedup,
            accuracy_drop=accuracy_drop,
            memory_reduction=memory_reduction,
            cost_reduction=cost_reduction
        )
    
    def _calculate_model_size(self, model: nn.Module) -> float:
        """Calculate model size in MB"""
        total_size = 0
        for param in model.parameters():
            total_size += param.numel() * param.element_size()
        for buffer in model.buffers():
            total_size += buffer.numel() * buffer.element_size()
        return total_size / (1024 * 1024)  # Convert to MB
    
    def _benchmark_inference_speed(self, 
                                  original_model: nn.Module,
                                  quantized_model: nn.Module,
                                  test_data: torch.Tensor,
                                  num_runs: int = 100) -> float:
        """Benchmark inference speed comparison"""
        
        # Warm up
        for _ in range(10):
            with torch.no_grad():
                _ = original_model(test_data[:1])
                _ = quantized_model(test_data[:1])
        
        # Benchmark original model
        original_model.eval()
        start_time = time.time()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for _ in range(num_runs):
                _ = original_model(test_data)
        original_time = time.time() - start_time
        
        # Benchmark quantized model
        quantized_model.eval()
        start_time = time.time()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for _ in range(num_runs):
                _ = quantized_model(test_data)
        quantized_time = time.time() - start_time
        
        speedup = original_time / quantized_time if quantized_time > 0 else 1.0
        return speedup
    
    def _estimate_accuracy_drop(self, 
                               original_model: nn.Module,
                               quantized_model: nn.Module,
                               test_data: torch.Tensor) -> float:
        """Estimate accuracy drop (simplified implementation)"""
        
        original_model.eval()
        quantized_model.eval()
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            original_output = original_model(test_data)
            quantized_output = quantized_model(test_data)
            
            # Calculate output difference as proxy for accuracy drop
            mse_diff = torch.nn.functional.mse_loss(original_output, quantized_output)
            
            # Normalize to percentage
            accuracy_drop = min(mse_diff.item() * 100, 100.0)
            
        return accuracy_drop
    
    def _estimate_memory_reduction(self, method_name: str, size_reduction: float) -> float:
        """Estimate memory reduction during inference"""
        
        # Different quantization methods have different memory impacts
        memory_factors = {
            'dynamic': 0.7,  # Dynamic quantization has less memory reduction
            'static': 0.9,   # Static quantization has better memory reduction
            'qat': 0.9,      # QAT similar to static
            'fp16': 0.5      # FP16 reduces memory by ~50%
        }
        
        factor = memory_factors.get(method_name, 0.8)
        return size_reduction * factor
    
    def _calculate_cost_reduction(self, 
                                 size_reduction: float,
                                 speedup: float,
                                 memory_reduction: float) -> float:
        """Calculate overall cost reduction"""
        
        # Weight different factors
        storage_weight = 0.3
        compute_weight = 0.5
        memory_weight = 0.2
        
        compute_reduction = 1.0 - (1.0 / speedup) if speedup > 1.0 else 0.0
        
        total_reduction = (
            storage_weight * size_reduction +
            compute_weight * compute_reduction +
            memory_weight * memory_reduction
        )
        
        return total_reduction
    
    def find_optimal_quantization(self, 
                                 benchmark_results: Dict[str, QuantizationMetrics],
                                 accuracy_threshold: float = 0.05) -> Tuple[str, QuantizationMetrics]:
        """Find optimal quantization method based on cost-accuracy trade-off"""
        
        valid_methods = {}
        
        for method, metrics in benchmark_results.items():
            if metrics.accuracy_drop <= accuracy_threshold:
                valid_methods[method] = metrics
        
        if not valid_methods:
            # If no method meets accuracy threshold, choose the one with least accuracy drop
            best_method = min(benchmark_results.keys(), 
                            key=lambda x: benchmark_results[x].accuracy_drop)
            return best_method, benchmark_results[best_method]
        
        # Among valid methods, choose the one with highest cost reduction
        best_method = max(valid_methods.keys(),
                         key=lambda x: valid_methods[x].cost_reduction)
        
        return best_method, valid_methods[best_method]

class ProgressiveQuantizer:
    """Progressive quantization with gradual bit reduction"""
    
    def __init__(self, model: nn.Module):
        self.model = model
        self.quantization_history = []
    
    def progressive_quantize(self, 
                           bit_levels: List[int] = [16, 8, 4],
                           validation_data: torch.Tensor,
                           accuracy_threshold: float = 0.95) -> List[Tuple[int, QuantizationMetrics]]:
        """Apply progressive quantization with different bit levels"""
        
        results = []
        current_model = copy.deepcopy(self.model)
        
        # Baseline accuracy
        baseline_accuracy = self._evaluate_accuracy(current_model, validation_data)
        
        for bit_level in bit_levels:
            print(f"Testing {bit_level}-bit quantization...")
            
            # Apply quantization
            if bit_level == 16:
                quantized_model = MixedPrecisionQuantizer.convert_to_fp16(current_model)
            elif bit_level == 8:
                quantized_model = DynamicQuantizer.quantize_linear_layers(current_model)
            elif bit_level == 4:
                # Custom 4-bit quantization
                quantized_model = self._apply_4bit_quantization(current_model)
            else:
                continue
            
            # Evaluate quantized model
            quantized_accuracy = self._evaluate_accuracy(quantized_model, validation_data)
            accuracy_retention = quantized_accuracy / baseline_accuracy
            
            if accuracy_retention >= accuracy_threshold:
                # Calculate metrics
                original_size = sum(p.numel() * p.element_size() for p in current_model.parameters()) / (1024 * 1024)
                quantized_size = sum(p.numel() * p.element_size() for p in quantized_model.parameters()) / (1024 * 1024)
                
                metrics = QuantizationMetrics(
                    original_size_mb=original_size,
                    quantized_size_mb=quantized_size,
                    size_reduction=(original_size - quantized_size) / original_size,
                    inference_speedup=self._estimate_speedup(bit_level),
                    accuracy_drop=1.0 - accuracy_retention,
                    memory_reduction=0.8 * (original_size - quantized_size) / original_size,
                    cost_reduction=0.0  # Will be calculated
                )
                
                results.append((bit_level, metrics))
                current_model = quantized_model  # Use quantized model for next iteration
                
                print(f"  {bit_level}-bit: Accuracy retention {accuracy_retention:.2%}, "
                      f"Size reduction {metrics.size_reduction:.2%}")
            else:
                print(f"  {bit_level}-bit: Failed accuracy threshold "
                      f"(retention: {accuracy_retention:.2%})")
                break
        
        return results
    
    def _apply_4bit_quantization(self, model: nn.Module) -> nn.Module:
        """Apply custom 4-bit quantization"""
        quantized_model = copy.deepcopy(model)
        
        for module in quantized_model.modules():
            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
                CustomQuantizer.quantize_layer_weights(module, num_bits=4)
        
        return quantized_model
    
    def _evaluate_accuracy(self, model: nn.Module, validation_data: torch.Tensor) -> float:
        """Evaluate model accuracy (simplified)"""
        model.eval()
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            output = model(validation_data)
            # Simplified accuracy calculation
            predictions = torch.argmax(output, dim=1)
            # Generate dummy targets for demo
            targets = torch.randint(0, output.size(1), (output.size(0),))
            accuracy = (predictions == targets).float().mean().item()
        
        return accuracy
    
    def _estimate_speedup(self, bit_level: int) -> float:
        """Estimate speedup based on bit level"""
        speedup_factors = {
            16: 1.2,
            8: 2.0,
            4: 3.5
        }
        return speedup_factors.get(bit_level, 1.0)

import torch

class ServerlessProvider(Enum):
    AWS_LAMBDA = "aws_lambda"
    AZURE_FUNCTIONS = "azure_functions"
    GOOGLE_CLOUD_FUNCTIONS = "google_cloud_functions"
    VERCEL = "vercel"
    NETLIFY = "netlify"

class InvocationType(Enum):
    SYNCHRONOUS = "sync"
    ASYNCHRONOUS = "async"
    STREAMING = "streaming"

@dataclass
class ServerlessConfig:
    provider: ServerlessProvider
    function_name: str
    region: str
    memory_mb: int = 512
    timeout_seconds: int = 30
    concurrent_executions: int = 100
    environment_variables: Dict[str, str] = None

@dataclass
class InferenceRequest:
    request_id: str
    model_id: str
    input_data: Any
    parameters: Dict[str, Any] = None
    callback_url: Optional[str] = None
    priority: int = 1

@dataclass
class InferenceResponse:
    request_id: str
    predictions: Any
    confidence: float
    processing_time: float
    cold_start: bool
    cost: float
    error: Optional[str] = None

@dataclass
class ServerlessMetrics:
    total_invocations: int
    cold_starts: int
    warm_starts: int
    average_latency: float
    p95_latency: float
    total_cost: float
    cost_per_invocation: float
    error_rate: float

class ModelSerializer:
    """Serialize models for serverless deployment"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def serialize_model(model: nn.Module, compress: bool = True) -> str:
        """Serialize model to base64 string"""
        # Save model state
        model_data = {
            'state_dict': model.state_dict(),
            'architecture': str(model),
            'metadata': {
                'parameters': sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()),
                'size_bytes': sum(p.numel() * p.element_size() for p in model.parameters())
            }
        }
        
        # Pickle and optionally compress
        pickled_data = pickle.dumps(model_data)
        
        if compress:
            pickled_data = gzip.compress(pickled_data)
        
        # Encode to base64
        encoded_data = base64.b64encode(pickled_data).decode('utf-8')
        
        return encoded_data
    
    @staticmethod
    def deserialize_model(encoded_data: str, 
                         model_class: Callable,
                         compressed: bool = True) -> nn.Module:
        """Deserialize model from base64 string"""
        
        # Decode from base64
        pickled_data = base64.b64decode(encoded_data.encode('utf-8'))
        
        # Decompress if needed
        if compressed:
            pickled_data = gzip.decompress(pickled_data)
        
        # Unpickle
        model_data = pickle.loads(pickled_data)
        
        # Reconstruct model
        model = model_class()
        model.load_state_dict(model_data['state_dict'])
        model.eval()
        
        return model

class ColdStartOptimizer:

                                 postprocessing_fn: Optional[Callable] = None) -> str:

        pickled_data = gzip.decompress(pickled_data)
        model_data_dict = pickle.loads(pickled_data)

def postprocess_output(output):

    return output

    @staticmethod
    def optimize_model_size(model: nn.Module,

        """Optimize model size for serverless constraints"""

        return optimized_model

class ServerlessInferenceClient:
    """Client for invoking serverless inference functions"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ServerlessConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.metrics = ServerlessMetrics(
            total_invocations=0,
            cold_starts=0,
            warm_starts=0,
            average_latency=0.0,
            p95_latency=0.0,
            total_cost=0.0,
            cost_per_invocation=0.0,
            error_rate=0.0
        )
        self.latencies = []
        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=10)
        
    async def invoke_async(self, request: InferenceRequest) -> InferenceResponse:
        """Asynchronous function invocation"""
        
        start_time = time.time()
        
        # Prepare payload
        payload = {
            'request_id': request.request_id,
            'model_id': request.model_id,
            'input_data': request.input_data,
            'parameters': request.parameters or {}
        }
        
        try:
            # Simulate serverless function call
            response_data = await self._simulate_function_call(payload)
            
            latency = time.time() - start_time
            self._update_metrics(latency, response_data.get('cold_start', False))
            
            return InferenceResponse(
                request_id=request.request_id,
                predictions=response_data.get('predictions'),
                confidence=response_data.get('confidence', 0.0),
                processing_time=response_data.get('processing_time', latency),
                cold_start=response_data.get('cold_start', False),
                cost=self._calculate_cost(latency, response_data.get('cold_start', False)),
                error=None
            )
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.metrics.total_invocations += 1
            return InferenceResponse(
                request_id=request.request_id,
                predictions=None,
                confidence=0.0,
                processing_time=time.time() - start_time,
                cold_start=False,
                cost=0.0,
                error=str(e)
            )
    
    def invoke_sync(self, request: InferenceRequest) -> InferenceResponse:
        """Synchronous function invocation"""
        return asyncio.run(self.invoke_async(request))
    
    def invoke_batch(self, 
                    requests: List[InferenceRequest],
                    max_concurrent: int = 10) -> List[InferenceResponse]:
        """Batch function invocation with concurrency control"""
        
        async def process_batch():
            semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)
            
            async def process_request(req):
                async with semaphore:
                    return await self.invoke_async(req)
            
            tasks = [process_request(req) for req in requests]
            return await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
        
        return asyncio.run(process_batch())
    
    async def _simulate_function_call(self, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Simulate serverless function execution"""
        
        # Simulate cold start probability (20% chance)
        cold_start = time.time() % 1 < 0.2
        
        # Simulate processing time
        if cold_start:
            processing_time = 0.5 + (time.time() % 1) * 2.0  # 0.5-2.5s for cold start
        else:
            processing_time = 0.05 + (time.time() % 1) * 0.2  # 0.05-0.25s for warm start
        
        await asyncio.sleep(processing_time)
        
        # Simulate response
        return {
            'predictions': [0.1, 0.2, 0.7] if 'input_data' in payload else None,
            'confidence': 0.7,
            'processing_time': processing_time,
            'cold_start': cold_start
        }
    
    def _update_metrics(self, latency: float, cold_start: bool):
        """Update performance metrics"""
        self.metrics.total_invocations += 1
        
        if cold_start:
            self.metrics.cold_starts += 1
        else:
            self.metrics.warm_starts += 1
        
        self.latencies.append(latency)
        
        # Update average latency
        self.metrics.average_latency = sum(self.latencies) / len(self.latencies)
        
        # Update P95 latency
        if len(self.latencies) >= 20:  # Need sufficient samples
            sorted_latencies = sorted(self.latencies)
            p95_index = int(0.95 * len(sorted_latencies))
            self.metrics.p95_latency = sorted_latencies[p95_index]
    
    def _calculate_cost(self, latency: float, cold_start: bool) -> float:
        """Calculate invocation cost"""
        
        # Cost factors (simplified AWS Lambda pricing)
        memory_gb = self.config.memory_mb / 1024
        duration_seconds = latency
        
        # Request cost
        request_cost = 0.0000002  # $0.20 per 1M requests
        
        # Duration cost
        gb_seconds = memory_gb * duration_seconds
        duration_cost
```python
        duration_cost = gb_seconds * 0.0000166667  # $16.67 per 1M GB-seconds
        
        # Cold start penalty (additional cost for initialization)
        cold_start_cost = 0.000001 if cold_start else 0.0
        
        total_cost = request_cost + duration_cost + cold_start_cost
        self.metrics.total_cost += total_cost
        self.metrics.cost_per_invocation = self.metrics.total_cost / self.metrics.total_invocations
        
        return total_cost

class ServerlessModelManager:
    """Manage multiple serverless model deployments"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.deployed_models: Dict[str, ServerlessConfig] = {}
        self.clients: Dict[str, ServerlessInferenceClient] = {}
        self.model_registry: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        
    def register_model(self, 
                      model_id: str,
                      model: nn.Module,
                      config: ServerlessConfig,
                      preprocessing_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
                      postprocessing_fn: Optional[Callable] = None):
        """Register a model for serverless deployment"""
        
        # Optimize model for serverless constraints
        optimized_model = ColdStartOptimizer.optimize_model_size(model, target_size_mb=10.0)
        
        # Serialize model
        serialized_model = ModelSerializer.serialize_model(optimized_model)
        
        # Store model information
        self.model_registry[model_id] = {
            'config': config,
            'serialized_model': serialized_model,
            'preprocessing_fn': preprocessing_fn,
            'postprocessing_fn': postprocessing_fn,
            'model_size_mb': sum(p.numel() * p.element_size() for p in optimized_model.parameters()) / (1024 * 1024)
        }
        
        # Create client
        self.clients[model_id] = ServerlessInferenceClient(config)
        
        print(f"Registered model {model_id} for serverless deployment")
        print(f"  Model size: {self.model_registry[model_id]['model_size_mb']:.2f} MB")
        print(f"  Memory allocation: {config.memory_mb} MB")
        print(f"  Timeout: {config.timeout_seconds}s")
    
    def deploy_model(self, model_id: str) -> bool:
        """Deploy model to serverless platform"""
        
        if model_id not in self.model_registry:
            print(f"Model {model_id} not registered")
            return False
        
        model_info = self.model_registry[model_id]
        config = model_info['config']
        
        # Generate deployment package
        handler_code = ColdStartOptimizer.create_lightweight_handler(
            model_factory=lambda: None,  # Placeholder
            model_data=model_info['serialized_model']
        )
        
        # Simulate deployment
        print(f"Deploying model {model_id} to {config.provider.value}...")
        print(f"  Function name: {config.function_name}")
        print(f"  Region: {config.region}")
        print(f"  Memory: {config.memory_mb} MB")
        
        self.deployed_models[model_id] = config
        
        return True
    
    def predict(self, 
               model_id: str,
               input_data: Any,
               request_id: Optional[str] = None) -> InferenceResponse:
        """Make prediction using deployed model"""
        
        if model_id not in self.clients:
            raise ValueError(f"Model {model_id} not found")
        
        if request_id is None:
            request_id = f"req_{int(time.time() * 1000000)}"
        
        request = InferenceRequest(
            request_id=request_id,
            model_id=model_id,
            input_data=input_data
        )
        
        return self.clients[model_id].invoke_sync(request)
    
    def predict_batch(self,
                     model_id: str,
                     batch_data: List[Any],
                     max_concurrent: int = 10) -> List[InferenceResponse]:
        """Make batch predictions"""
        
        if model_id not in self.clients:
            raise ValueError(f"Model {model_id} not found")
        
        requests = [
            InferenceRequest(
                request_id=f"batch_{i}_{int(time.time() * 1000000)}",
                model_id=model_id,
                input_data=data
            )
            for i, data in enumerate(batch_data)
        ]
        
        return self.clients[model_id].invoke_batch(requests, max_concurrent)
    
    def get_model_metrics(self, model_id: str) -> Optional[ServerlessMetrics]:
        """Get performance metrics for a model"""
        
        if model_id in self.clients:
            return self.clients[model_id].metrics
        return None
    
    def optimize_deployment(self, model_id: str, target_latency: float = 1.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Optimize deployment configuration for target latency"""
        
        if model_id not in self.model_registry:
            return {}
        
        model_info = self.model_registry[model_id]
        current_config = model_info['config']
        
        # Test different memory configurations
        memory_options = [128, 256, 512, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3008]
        best_config = None
        best_cost_efficiency = 0.0
        
        print(f"Optimizing deployment for {model_id}...")
        
        for memory_mb in memory_options:
            if memory_mb < model_info['model_size_mb'] * 2:  # Need at least 2x model size
                continue
            
            # Create test configuration
            test_config = ServerlessConfig(
                provider=current_config.provider,
                function_name=current_config.function_name,
                region=current_config.region,
                memory_mb=memory_mb,
                timeout_seconds=current_config.timeout_seconds
            )
            
            # Simulate performance
            estimated_latency = self._estimate_latency(model_info['model_size_mb'], memory_mb)
            estimated_cost = self._estimate_cost(memory_mb, estimated_latency)
            
            if estimated_latency <= target_latency:
                cost_efficiency = 1.0 / (estimated_cost * estimated_latency)
                
                if cost_efficiency > best_cost_efficiency:
                    best_cost_efficiency = cost_efficiency
                    best_config = {
                        'memory_mb': memory_mb,
                        'estimated_latency': estimated_latency,
                        'estimated_cost': estimated_cost
                    }
        
        return best_config or {}
    
    def _estimate_latency(self, model_size_mb: float, memory_mb: int) -> float:
        """Estimate inference latency based on model size and memory"""
        
        # Base latency components
        cold_start_latency = 0.5 + (model_size_mb * 0.1)  # Model loading time
        warm_start_latency = 0.05 + (model_size_mb * 0.01)  # Inference time
        
        # Memory factor (more memory = faster execution)
        memory_factor = max(0.5, 1.0 - (memory_mb - 128) / 2000)
        
        return warm_start_latency * memory_factor
    
    def _estimate_cost(self, memory_mb: int, latency: float) -> float:
        """Estimate cost per invocation"""
        
        memory_gb = memory_mb / 1024
        gb_seconds = memory_gb * latency
        
        request_cost = 0.0000002
        duration_cost = gb_seconds * 0.0000166667
        
        return request_cost + duration_cost

class ServerlessLoadBalancer:
    """Load balancer for serverless inference"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.model_endpoints: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        self.endpoint_weights: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] = {}
        self.endpoint_health: Dict[str, Dict[str, bool]] = {}
        
    def register_endpoint(self, 
                         model_id: str,
                         endpoint_id: str,
                         weight: float = 1.0):
        """Register an endpoint for load balancing"""
        
        if model_id not in self.model_endpoints:
            self.model_endpoints[model_id] = []
            self.endpoint_weights[model_id] = {}
            self.endpoint_health[model_id] = {}
        
        self.model_endpoints[model_id].append(endpoint_id)
        self.endpoint_weights[model_id][endpoint_id] = weight
        self.endpoint_health[model_id][endpoint_id] = True
    
    def select_endpoint(self, model_id: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Select endpoint using weighted round-robin"""
        
        if model_id not in self.model_endpoints:
            return None
        
        # Filter healthy endpoints
        healthy_endpoints = [
            endpoint for endpoint in self.model_endpoints[model_id]
            if self.endpoint_health[model_id][endpoint]
        ]
        
        if not healthy_endpoints:
            return None
        
        # Weighted selection (simplified)
        total_weight = sum(
            self.endpoint_weights[model_id][endpoint] 
            for endpoint in healthy_endpoints
        )
        
        if total_weight == 0:
            return healthy_endpoints[0]
        
        # Select based on weights
        import random
        rand_val = random.uniform(0, total_weight)
        current_weight = 0
        
        for endpoint in healthy_endpoints:
            current_weight += self.endpoint_weights[model_id][endpoint]
            if rand_val <= current_weight:
                return endpoint
        
        return healthy_endpoints[0]
    
    def update_endpoint_health(self, 
                              model_id: str,
                              endpoint_id: str,
                              is_healthy: bool):
        """Update endpoint health status"""
        
        if (model_id in self.endpoint_health and 
            endpoint_id in self.endpoint_health[model_id]):
            self.endpoint_health[model_id][endpoint_id] = is_healthy

## 1077. Cold Start Optimization Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import time
import threading
import asyncio
import pickle
import gzip
import base64
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Callable, Union
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
import os
import json
import hashlib
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import psutil

class WarmupStrategy(Enum):
    SCHEDULED = "scheduled"
    PREDICTIVE = "predictive"
    KEEP_WARM = "keep_warm"
    LAZY_INIT = "lazy_init"

class OptimizationLevel(Enum):
    BASIC = "basic"
    AGGRESSIVE = "aggressive"
    ULTRA = "ultra"

@dataclass
class ColdStartConfig:
    warmup_strategy: WarmupStrategy
    optimization_level: OptimizationLevel
    warmup_interval: int = 300  # seconds
    keep_warm_instances: int = 1
    max_warmup_concurrency: int = 5
    preload_models: bool = True
    enable_jit: bool = True

@dataclass
class ColdStartMetrics:
    cold_start_count: int
    warm_start_count: int
    avg_cold_start_time: float
    avg_warm_start_time: float
    warmup_success_rate: float
    memory_overhead: float
    cost_overhead: float

class ModelPreloader:
    """Preload and optimize models for fast cold starts"""
    
    def __init__(self, optimization_level: OptimizationLevel = OptimizationLevel.BASIC):
        self.optimization_level = optimization_level
        self.preloaded_models: Dict[str, nn.Module] = {}
        self.model_metadata: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
        self.jit_cache: Dict[str, torch.jit.ScriptModule] = {}
        
    def preload_model(self, 
                     model_id: str,
                     model_factory: Callable,
                     sample_input: torch.Tensor,
                     model_args: tuple = (),
                     model_kwargs: dict = None) -> float:
        """Preload and optimize model for fast inference"""
        
        start_time = time.time()
        
        if model_kwargs is None:
            model_kwargs = {}
            
        # Create model instance
        model = model_factory(*model_args, **model_kwargs)
        model.eval()
        
        # Apply optimizations based on level
        optimized_model = self._optimize_model(model, sample_input)
        
        # Store preloaded model
        self.preloaded_models[model_id] = optimized_model
        
        # Store metadata
        self.model_metadata[model_id] = {
            'load_time': time.time() - start_time,
            'memory_usage': self._get_model_memory_usage(optimized_model),
            'optimization_level': self.optimization_level.value,
            'jit_compiled': model_id in self.jit_cache
        }
        
        return time.time() - start_time
    
    def get_model(self, model_id: str) -> Optional[nn.Module]:
        """Get preloaded model"""
        return self.preloaded_models.get(model_id)
    
    def _optimize_model(self, model: nn.Module, sample_input: torch.Tensor) -> nn.Module:
        """Apply optimizations based on optimization level"""
        
        optimized_model = model
        
        if self.optimization_level == OptimizationLevel.BASIC:
            # Basic optimizations
            optimized_model = self._apply_basic_optimizations(optimized_model, sample_input)
            
        elif self.optimization_level == OptimizationLevel.AGGRESSIVE:
            # Aggressive optimizations
            optimized_model = self._apply_basic_optimizations(optimized_model, sample_input)
            optimized_model = self._apply_aggressive_optimizations(optimized_model, sample_input)
            
        elif self.optimization_level == OptimizationLevel.ULTRA:
            # Ultra optimizations
            optimized_model = self._apply_basic_optimizations(optimized_model, sample_input)
            optimized_model = self._apply_aggressive_optimizations(optimized_model, sample_input)
            optimized_model = self._apply_ultra_optimizations(optimized_model, sample_input)
        
        return optimized_model
    
    def _apply_basic_optimizations(self, model: nn.Module, sample_input: torch.Tensor) -> nn.Module:
        """Apply basic optimizations"""
        
        # Disable gradients
        for param in model.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
            
        # Warmup with sample input
        with torch.no_grad():
            for _ in range(3):
                _ = model(sample_input)
        
        return model
    
    def _apply_aggressive_optimizations(self, model: nn.Module, sample_input: torch.Tensor) -> nn.Module:
        """Apply aggressive optimizations"""
        
        # JIT compilation
        try:
            model_id = hashlib.md5(str(model).encode()).hexdigest()
            
            with torch.no_grad():
                jit_model = torch.jit.trace(model, sample_input)
                jit_model.eval()
                
                # Warmup JIT model
                for _ in range(5):
                    _ = jit_model(sample_input)
                    
                self.jit_cache[model_id] = jit_model
                return jit_model
                
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"JIT compilation failed: {e}")
            return model
    
    def _apply_ultra_optimizations(self, model: nn.Module, sample_input: torch.Tensor) -> nn.Module:
        """Apply ultra optimizations"""
        
        # Model fusion and other advanced optimizations
        try:
            # Apply dynamic quantization for inference speedup
            quantized_model = torch.quantization.quantize_dynamic(
                model, {nn.Linear}, dtype=torch.qint8
            )
            
            # Warmup quantized model
            with torch.no_grad():
                for _ in range(5):
                    _ = quantized_model(sample_input)
                    
            return quantized_model
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Ultra optimization failed: {e}")
            return model
    
    def _get_model_memory_usage(self, model: nn.Module) -> float:
        """Estimate model memory usage in MB"""
        total_size = 0
        for param in model.parameters():
            total_size += param.numel() * param.element_size()
        for buffer in model.buffers():
            total_size += buffer.numel() * buffer.element_size()
        return total_size / (1024 * 1024)

class WarmupScheduler:
    """Schedule warmup operations to prevent cold starts"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ColdStartConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.warmup_tasks: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
        self.scheduler_running = False
        self.scheduler_thread: Optional[threading.Thread] = None
        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=config.max_warmup_concurrency)
        
    def schedule_warmup(self, 
                       function_name: str,
                       warmup_fn: Callable,
                       warmup_interval: Optional[int] = None):
        """Schedule periodic warmup for a function"""
        
        interval = warmup_interval or self.config.warmup_interval
        
        self.warmup_tasks[function_name] = {
            'warmup_fn': warmup_fn,
            'interval': interval,
            'last_warmup': 0,
            'warmup_count': 0,
            'success_count': 0
        }
        
        print(f"Scheduled warmup for {function_name} every {interval} seconds")
    
    def start_scheduler(self):
        """Start the warmup scheduler"""
        if not self.scheduler_running:
            self.scheduler_running = True
            self.scheduler_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._scheduler_loop)
            self.scheduler_thread.daemon = True
            self.scheduler_thread.start()
            print("Warmup scheduler started")
    
    def stop_scheduler(self):
        """Stop the warmup scheduler"""
        self.scheduler_running = False
        if self.scheduler_thread:
            self.scheduler_thread.join()
        self.executor.shutdown(wait=True)
        print("Warmup scheduler stopped")
    
    def _scheduler_loop(self):
        """Main scheduler loop"""
        while self.scheduler_running:
            current_time = time.time()
            
            for function_name, task_info in self.warmup_tasks.items():
                time_since_last = current_time - task_info['last_warmup']
                
                if time_since_last >= task_info['interval']:
                    # Submit warmup task
                    future = self.executor.submit(self._execute_warmup, function_name, task_info)
                    task_info['last_warmup'] = current_time
            
            time.sleep(10)  # Check every 10 seconds
    
    def _execute_warmup(self, function_name: str, task_info: Dict):
        """Execute warmup task"""
        try:
            task_info['warmup_count'] += 1
            task_info['warmup_fn']()
            task_info['success_count'] += 1
            print(f"Warmup successful for {function_name}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warmup failed for {function_name}: {e}")

class PredictiveWarmer:
    """Predictive warmup based on usage patterns"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.access_patterns: Dict[str, List[float]] = {}
        self.warmup_predictions: Dict[str, float] = {}
        self.prediction_accuracy: Dict[str, float] = {}
        
    def record_access(self, function_name: str, timestamp: Optional[float] = None):
        """Record function access for pattern analysis"""
        if timestamp is None:
            timestamp = time.time()
            
        if function_name not in self.access_patterns:
            self.access_patterns[function_name] = []
            
        self.access_patterns[function_name].append(timestamp)
        
        # Keep only recent history (last 24 hours)
        cutoff_time = timestamp - 86400
        self.access_patterns[function_name] = [
            t for t in self.access_patterns[function_name] if t > cutoff_time
        ]
        
        # Update predictions
        self._update_predictions(function_name)
    
    def should_warmup(self, function_name: str, current_time: Optional[float] = None) -> bool:
        """Determine if function should be warmed up based on predictions"""
        if current_time is None:
            current_time = time.time()
            
        if function_name not in self.warmup_predictions:
            return False
            
        predicted_access_time = self.warmup_predictions[function_name]
        
        # Warmup if predicted access is within next 5 minutes
        return (predicted_access_time - current_time) <= 300
    
    def _update_predictions(self, function_name: str):
        """Update access time predictions"""
        access_times = self.access_patterns[function_name]
        
        if len(access_times) < 3:
            return
            
        # Simple prediction: next access based on average interval
        intervals = [access_times[i] - access_times[i-1] for i in range(1, len(access_times))]
        avg_interval = sum(intervals) / len(intervals)
        
        # Predict next access time
        last_access = access_times[-1]
        predicted_next = last_access + avg_interval
        
        self.warmup_predictions[function_name] = predicted_next

class KeepWarmManager:
    """Maintain warm instances to eliminate cold starts"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ColdStartConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.warm_instances: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = {}
        self.instance_locks: Dict[str, threading.Lock] = {}
        
    def initialize_warm_pool(self, 
                           function_name: str,
                           instance_factory: Callable,
                           pool_size: Optional[int] = None):
        """Initialize pool of warm instances"""
        
        pool_size = pool_size or self.config.keep_warm_instances
        
        self.warm_instances[function_name] = []
        self.instance_locks[function_name] = threading.Lock()
        
        # Create initial warm instances
        for i in range(pool_size):
            instance = self._create_warm_instance(function_name, instance_factory)
            self.warm_instances[function_name].append(instance)
        
        print(f"Initialized warm pool for {function_name} with {pool_size} instances")
    
    def get_warm_instance(self, function_name: str) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Get a warm instance from the pool"""
        if function_name not in self.warm_instances:
            return None
            
        with self.instance_locks[function_name]:
            if self.warm_instances[function_name]:
                instance = self.warm_instances[function_name].pop(0)
                instance['last_used'] = time.time()
                return instance
        
        return None
    
    def return_instance(self, function_name: str, instance: Dict):
        """Return instance to the warm pool"""
        if function_name not in self.warm_instances:
            return
            
        with self.instance_locks[function_name]:
            # Check if pool is not full
            if len(self.warm_instances[function_name]) < self.config.keep_warm_instances:
                instance['returned_at'] = time.time()
                self.warm_instances[function_name].append(instance)
    
    def _create_warm_instance(self, function_name: str, instance_factory: Callable) -> Dict:
        """Create a new warm instance"""
        start_time = time.time()
        instance_data = instance_factory()
        
        return {
            'function_name': function_name,
            'instance_data': instance_data,
            'created_at': time.time(),
            'warmup_time': time.time() - start_time,
            'last_used': 0,
            'use_count': 0
        }

class ColdStartOptimizer:
    """Main cold start optimization system"""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ColdStartConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.preloader = ModelPreloader(config.optimization_level)
        self.scheduler = WarmupScheduler(config)
        self.predictor = PredictiveWarmer()
        self.keep_warm = KeepWarmManager(config)
        self.metrics = ColdStartMetrics(
            cold_start_count=0,
            warm_start_count=0,
            avg_cold_start_time=0.0,
            avg_warm_start_time=0.0,
            warmup_success_rate=0.0,
            memory_overhead=0.0,
            cost_overhead=0.0
        )
        self.cold_start_times: List[float] = []
        self.warm_start_times: List[float] = []
        
    def register_function(self, 
                         function_name: str,
                         model_factory: Callable,
                         sample_input: torch.Tensor,
```python
                         sample_input: torch.Tensor,
                         warmup_fn: Optional[Callable] = None,
                         instance_factory: Optional[Callable] = None):
        """Register function for cold start optimization"""
        
        print(f"Registering function {function_name} for cold start optimization")
        
        # Preload model if enabled
        if self.config.preload_models:
            preload_time = self.preloader.preload_model(
                function_name, model_factory, sample_input
            )
            print(f"  Model preloaded in {preload_time:.3f}s")
        
        # Setup warmup based on strategy
        if self.config.warmup_strategy == WarmupStrategy.SCHEDULED:
            if warmup_fn:
                self.scheduler.schedule_warmup(function_name, warmup_fn)
            
        elif self.config.warmup_strategy == WarmupStrategy.KEEP_WARM:
            if instance_factory:
                self.keep_warm.initialize_warm_pool(function_name, instance_factory)
                
        # Start scheduler if not running
        if not self.scheduler.scheduler_running:
            self.scheduler.start_scheduler()
    
    def execute_function(self, 
                        function_name: str,
                        execution_fn: Callable,
                        *args, **kwargs) -> Any:
        """Execute function with cold start optimization"""
        
        start_time = time.time()
        is_cold_start = True
        
        # Record access for predictive warming
        if self.config.warmup_strategy == WarmupStrategy.PREDICTIVE:
            self.predictor.record_access(function_name)
        
        # Try to get warm instance
        if self.config.warmup_strategy == WarmupStrategy.KEEP_WARM:
            warm_instance = self.keep_warm.get_warm_instance(function_name)
            if warm_instance:
                is_cold_start = False
                warm_instance['use_count'] += 1
                
                # Execute with warm instance
                try:
                    result = execution_fn(warm_instance['instance_data'], *args, **kwargs)
                    
                    # Return instance to pool
                    self.keep_warm.return_instance(function_name, warm_instance)
                    
                    execution_time = time.time() - start_time
                    self._record_execution(execution_time, is_cold_start)
                    
                    return result
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Warm instance execution failed: {e}")
                    # Fall back to cold start
                    is_cold_start = True
        
        # Get preloaded model if available
        preloaded_model = None
        if self.config.preload_models:
            preloaded_model = self.preloader.get_model(function_name)
            if preloaded_model:
                is_cold_start = False
        
        # Execute function (cold start or with preloaded model)
        try:
            if preloaded_model:
                result = execution_fn(preloaded_model, *args, **kwargs)
            else:
                result = execution_fn(*args, **kwargs)
                
            execution_time = time.time() - start_time
            self._record_execution(execution_time, is_cold_start)
            
            return result
            
        except Exception as e:
            execution_time = time.time() - start_time
            self._record_execution(execution_time, is_cold_start)
            raise e
    
    def _record_execution(self, execution_time: float, is_cold_start: bool):
        """Record execution metrics"""
        if is_cold_start:
            self.metrics.cold_start_count += 1
            self.cold_start_times.append(execution_time)
            self.metrics.avg_cold_start_time = sum(self.cold_start_times) / len(self.cold_start_times)
        else:
            self.metrics.warm_start_count += 1
            self.warm_start_times.append(execution_time)
            self.metrics.avg_warm_start_time = sum(self.warm_start_times) / len(self.warm_start_times)
    
    def get_metrics(self) -> ColdStartMetrics:
        """Get cold start optimization metrics"""
        total_executions = self.metrics.cold_start_count + self.metrics.warm_start_count
        
        if total_executions > 0:
            # Calculate warmup success rate
            warmup_success_rate = self.metrics.warm_start_count / total_executions
            self.metrics.warmup_success_rate = warmup_success_rate
            
            # Estimate memory overhead
            total_memory = sum(
                metadata['memory_usage'] 
                for metadata in self.preloader.model_metadata.values()
            )
            self.metrics.memory_overhead = total_memory
            
            # Estimate cost overhead (simplified)
            # Assume $0.01 per MB per hour for keeping models in memory
            hours_running = 1.0  # Simplified
            self.metrics.cost_overhead = total_memory * 0.01 * hours_running
        
        return self.metrics
    
    def optimize_for_pattern(self, function_name: str, access_pattern: List[float]):
        """Optimize warmup strategy based on access pattern"""
        
        if len(access_pattern) < 2:
            return
        
        # Analyze access pattern
        intervals = [access_pattern[i] - access_pattern[i-1] for i in range(1, len(access_pattern))]
        avg_interval = sum(intervals) / len(intervals)
        interval_variance = sum((x - avg_interval) ** 2 for x in intervals) / len(intervals)
        
        print(f"Access pattern analysis for {function_name}:")
        print(f"  Average interval: {avg_interval:.1f}s")
        print(f"  Interval variance: {interval_variance:.1f}")
        
        # Recommend optimization strategy
        if avg_interval < 300 and interval_variance < 100:
            # Regular, frequent access - use keep warm
            print(f"  Recommendation: Use KEEP_WARM strategy")
        elif avg_interval < 3600:
            # Moderate frequency - use scheduled warmup
            print(f"  Recommendation: Use SCHEDULED warmup every {int(avg_interval * 0.8)}s")
        else:
            # Infrequent access - use predictive warmup
            print(f"  Recommendation: Use PREDICTIVE warmup")
    
    def shutdown(self):
        """Shutdown cold start optimizer"""
        self.scheduler.stop_scheduler()

class LazyInitializer:
    """Lazy initialization for expensive operations"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self._initialized_components: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._initialization_functions: Dict[str, Callable] = {}
        self._initialization_locks: Dict[str, threading.Lock] = {}
        
    def register_component(self, component_name: str, init_fn: Callable):
        """Register a component for lazy initialization"""
        self._initialization_functions[component_name] = init_fn
        self._initialization_locks[component_name] = threading.Lock()
        
    def get_component(self, component_name: str) -> Any:
        """Get component, initializing if necessary"""
        if component_name in self._initialized_components:
            return self._initialized_components[component_name]
        
        with self._initialization_locks[component_name]:
            # Double-check pattern
            if component_name in self._initialized_components:
                return self._initialized_components[component_name]
                
            # Initialize component
            if component_name in self._initialization_functions:
                start_time = time.time()
                component = self._initialization_functions[component_name]()
                init_time = time.time() - start_time
                
                self._initialized_components[component_name] = component
                print(f"Lazy initialized {component_name} in {init_time:.3f}s")
                
                return component
        
        raise ValueError(f"Component {component_name} not registered")
    
    def is_initialized(self, component_name: str) -> bool:
        """Check if component is initialized"""
        return component_name in self._initialized_components
    
    def clear_component(self, component_name: str):
        """Clear initialized component"""
        if component_name in self._initialized_components:
            del self._initialized_components[component_name]

class ServerlessFunction:
    """Optimized serverless function wrapper"""
    
    def __init__(self, 
                 function_name: str,
                 config: ColdStartConfig):
        self.function_name = function_name
        self.config = config
        self.optimizer = ColdStartOptimizer(config)
        self.lazy_init = LazyInitializer()
        self.is_warm = False
        self.warmup_time = 0.0
        
    def register_model(self, 
                      model_factory: Callable,
                      sample_input: torch.Tensor,
                      warmup_fn: Optional[Callable] = None):
        """Register model for the function"""
        
        # Register for cold start optimization
        self.optimizer.register_function(
            self.function_name,
            model_factory,
            sample_input,
            warmup_fn
        )
        
        # Register for lazy initialization
        self.lazy_init.register_component("model", lambda: model_factory())
        
    def execute(self, input_data: Any, **kwargs) -> Any:
        """Execute function with cold start optimization"""
        
        def execution_fn(*args, **kwargs):
            # Get model (lazy initialization)
            model = self.lazy_init.get_component("model")
            
            # Perform inference
            with torch.no_grad():
                if isinstance(input_data, list):
                    input_tensor = torch.tensor(input_data, dtype=torch.float32)
                else:
                    input_tensor = input_data
                    
                output = model(input_tensor)
                
                # Convert output to serializable format
                if hasattr(output, 'tolist'):
                    return output.tolist()
                return output
        
        return self.optimizer.execute_function(
            self.function_name,
            execution_fn,
            **kwargs
        )
    
    def warmup(self):
        """Manual warmup of the function"""
        start_time = time.time()
        
        # Initialize all components
        try:
            self.lazy_init.get_component("model")
            self.is_warm = True
            self.warmup_time = time.time() - start_time
            print(f"Function {self.function_name} warmed up in {self.warmup_time:.3f}s")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warmup failed for {self.function_name}: {e}")
    
    def get_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get function metrics"""
        optimizer_metrics = self.optimizer.get_metrics()
        
        return {
            'function_name': self.function_name,
            'is_warm': self.is_warm,
            'warmup_time': self.warmup_time,
            'cold_starts': optimizer_metrics.cold_start_count,
            'warm_starts': optimizer_metrics.warm_start_count,
            'avg_cold_start_time': optimizer_metrics.avg_cold_start_time,
            'avg_warm_start_time': optimizer_metrics.avg_warm_start_time,
            'warmup_success_rate': optimizer_metrics.warmup_success_rate,
            'memory_overhead': optimizer_metrics.memory_overhead,
            'cost_overhead': optimizer_metrics.cost_overhead
        }

## 1078. Warm Pool Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import threading
import time
import queue
import psutil
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Callable, Union
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import Enum
import uuid
import asyncio
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import logging

class PoolStrategy(Enum):
    FIXED_SIZE = "fixed_size"
    DYNAMIC = "dynamic"
    AUTO_SCALING = "auto_scaling"
    ADAPTIVE = "adaptive"

class InstanceState(Enum):
    INITIALIZING = "initializing"
    READY = "ready"
    BUSY = "busy"
    IDLE = "idle"
    TERMINATING = "terminating"
    FAILED = "failed"

@dataclass
class PoolConfig:
    strategy: PoolStrategy
    min_instances: int = 1
    max_instances: int = 10
    target_utilization: float = 0.7
    scale_up_threshold: float = 0.8
    scale_down_threshold: float = 0.3
    instance_timeout: int = 300  # seconds
    health_check_interval: int = 30
    warmup_time: int = 60

@dataclass
class InstanceMetrics:
    instance_id: str
    state: InstanceState
    created_at: float
    last_used: float
    total_requests: int
    active_requests: int
    avg_response_time: float
    memory_usage_mb: float
    cpu_usage_percent: float
    error_count: int

@dataclass
class PoolMetrics:
    total_instances: int
    ready_instances: int
    busy_instances: int
    idle_instances: int
    failed_instances: int
    avg_utilization: float
    avg_response_time: float
    total_requests: int
    queue_size: int
    scale_events: int

class WarmInstance:
    """Represents a warm instance in the pool"""
    
    def __init__(self, 
                 instance_id: str,
                 instance_factory: Callable,
                 health_check_fn: Optional[Callable] = None):
        self.instance_id = instance_id
        self.instance_factory = instance_factory
        self.health_check_fn = health_check_fn
        
        self.state = InstanceState.INITIALIZING
        self.instance_data = None
        self.created_at = time.time()
        self.last_used = time.time()
        self.last_health_check = 0.0
        
        # Metrics
        self.total_requests = 0
        self.active_requests = 0
        self.response_times = []
        self.error_count = 0
        
        # Locks
        self.state_lock = threading.Lock()
        self.metrics_lock = threading.Lock()
        
        # Initialize instance
        self._initialize()
    
    def _initialize(self):
        """Initialize the instance"""
        try:
            start_time = time.time()
            self.instance_data = self.instance_factory()
            init_time = time.time() - start_time
            
            with self.state_lock:
                self.state = InstanceState.READY
            
            logging.info(f"Instance {self.instance_id} initialized in {init_time:.3f}s")
            
        except Exception as e:
            with self.state_lock:
                self.state = InstanceState.FAILED
            logging.error(f"Instance {self.instance_id} initialization failed: {e}")
    
    def execute(self, task_fn: Callable, *args, **kwargs) -> Any:
        """Execute task on this instance"""
        if self.state != InstanceState.READY:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Instance {self.instance_id} not ready (state: {self.state})")
        
        start_time = time.time()
        
        try:
            with self.state_lock:
                self.state = InstanceState.BUSY
                
            with self.metrics_lock:
                self.active_requests += 1
                self.total_requests += 1
            
            # Execute task
            result = task_fn(self.instance_data, *args, **kwargs)
            
            # Record metrics
            response_time = time.time() - start_time
            with self.metrics_lock:
                self.response_times.append(response_time)
                # Keep only recent response times
                if len(self.response_times) > 100:
                    self.response_times = self.response_times[-100:]
                self.active_requests -= 1
                self.last_used = time.time()
            
            with self.state_lock:
                self.state = InstanceState.READY
            
            return result
            
        except Exception as e:
            with self.metrics_lock:
                self.error_count += 1
                self.active_requests -= 1
            
            with self.state_lock:
                self.state = InstanceState.READY
                
            raise e
    
    def health_check(self) -> bool:
        """Perform health check on instance"""
        if self.health_check_fn is None:
            return True
        
        try:
            self.last_health_check = time.time()
            return self.health_check_fn(self.instance_data)
        except Exception as e:
            logging.warning(f"Health check failed for instance {self.instance_id}: {e}")
            return False
    
    def get_metrics(self) -> InstanceMetrics:
        """Get instance metrics"""
        with self.metrics_lock:
            avg_response_time = (
                sum(self.response_times) / len(self.response_times)
                if self.response_times else 0.0
            )
            
            return InstanceMetrics(
                instance_id=self.instance_id,
                state=self.state,
                created_at=self.created_at,
                last_used=self.last_used,
                total_requests=self.total_requests,
                active_requests=self.active_requests,
                avg_response_time=avg_response_time,
                memory_usage_mb=self._get_memory_usage(),
                cpu_usage_percent=psutil.cpu_percent(),
                error_count=self.error_count
            )
    
    def _get_memory_usage(self) -> float:
        """Get memory usage for this instance (simplified)"""
        process = psutil.Process()
        return process.memory_info().rss / (1024 * 1024)  # MB
    
    def is_idle(self, idle_threshold: int = 300) -> bool:
        """Check if instance is idle"""
        return (
            self.state == InstanceState.READY and
            time.time() - self.last_used > idle_threshold
        )
    
    def terminate(self):
        """Terminate the instance"""
        with self.state_lock:
            self.state = InstanceState.TERMINATING
        
        # Cleanup instance data if needed
        if hasattr(self.instance_data, 'cleanup'):
            try:
                self.instance_data.cleanup()
            except:
                pass

class WarmPool:
    """Warm pool manager"""
    
    def __init__(self, 
                 pool_name: str,
                 config: PoolConfig,
                 instance_factory: Callable,
                 health_check_fn: Optional[Callable] = None):
        
        self.pool_name = pool_name
        self.config = config
        self.instance_factory = instance_factory
        self.health_check_fn = health_check_fn
        
        # Instance management
        self.instances: Dict[str, WarmInstance] = {}
        self.request_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.instances_lock = threading.RLock()
        
        # Metrics
        self.total_requests = 0
        self.queue_wait_times = []
        self.scale_events = 0
        self.metrics_lock = threading.Lock()
        
        # Background threads
        self.pool_manager_thread = None
        self.health_checker_thread = None
        self.auto_scaler_thread = None
        self.is_running = False
        
        # Initialize pool
        self._initialize_pool()
        self._start_background_threads()
    
    def _initialize_pool(self):
        """Initialize the warm pool with minimum instances"""
        logging.info(f"Initializing warm pool '{self.pool_name}' with {self.config.min_instances} instances")
        
        for i in range(self.config.min_instances):
            self._create_instance()
    
    def _create_instance(self) -> str:
        """Create a new warm instance"""
        instance_id = f"{self.pool_name}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
        
        instance = WarmInstance(
            instance_id=instance_id,
            instance_factory=self.instance_factory,
            health_check_fn=self.health_check_fn
        )
        
        with self.instances_lock:
            self.instances[instance_id] = instance
        
        logging.info(f"Created instance {instance_id}")
        return instance_id
    
    def _start_background_threads(self):
        """Start background management threads"""
        self.is_running = True
        
        # Pool manager thread
        self.pool_manager_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._pool_manager_loop)
        self.pool_manager_thread.daemon = True
        self.pool_manager_thread.start()
        
        # Health checker thread
        self.health_checker_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._health_checker_loop)
        self.health_checker_thread.daemon = True
        self.health_checker_thread.start()
        
        # Auto scaler thread (for dynamic strategies)
        if self.config.strategy in [PoolStrategy.DYNAMIC, PoolStrategy.AUTO_SCALING, PoolStrategy.ADAPTIVE]:
            self.auto_scaler_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._auto_scaler_loop)
            self.auto_scaler_thread.daemon = True
            self.auto_scaler_thread.start()
    
    def submit_task(self, task_fn: Callable, *args, **kwargs) -> Any:
        """Submit task to warm pool"""
        start_time = time.time()
        
        with self.metrics_lock:
            self.total_requests += 1
        
        # Try to get available instance
        instance = self._get_available_instance()
        
        if instance:
            # Execute immediately
            queue_wait_time = time.time() - start_time
            with self.metrics_lock:
                self.queue_wait_times.append(queue_wait_time)
                
            return instance.execute(
```python
